paper_title: Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time   Scaling
caption: Comparison between the performance of smaller LLMs compute-optimal TTS and that of larger LLMs CoT on MATH-500 and AIME24. (a) & (d) Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct surpasses Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct and GPT-4o on MATH-500 and AIME24; (b) & (e) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B outperforms o1-preview on MATH-500 and AIME24, and surpasses o1-mini on MATH-500; (c) & (f) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B beats o1 on MATH-500 and AIME24, and exceeds DeepSeek-R1 on AIME24.
model_annotation: The figure presents a set of six small bar charts comparing model performance scores under two prompting/strategy conditions (CoT shown as solid-filled bars and TTS shown as diagonally hatched bars, as indicated in the legend) for two benchmarks, with three panels for MATH-500 (labeled (a)–(c)) and three panels for AIME24 (labeled (d)–(f).) In each panel, the category axis is horizontal and lists three model-size categories in the order shown beneath the bars (some labeled with parameter counts such as “3B,” “405B,” “1.5B,” “7B,” “671B,” and some labeled “unk”); there is no explicit x-axis title. For MATH-500 panels (a)–(c), the vertical value axis uses a linear scale with tick labels from 65 to 100 at regular 5-point intervals (65, 70, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, 100), and each bar has its numeric value printed above it. Panel (a) contains three TTS (hatched) bars: a blue bar at “3B” labeled 78.2, a purple bar at “unk” labeled 74.6, and a green bar at “405B” labeled 71.4. Panel (b) contains three bars with values 91.6, 90.0, and 85.5, where the first bar at “1.5B” is red and hatched (TTS) at 91.6, the second bar at “unk” is solid pink (CoT) at 90.0, and the third bar at “unk” is solid brown (CoT) at 85.5. Panel (c) shows three solid (CoT) bars: a tan bar at “671B” labeled 97.3, an orange hatched (TTS) bar at “7B” labeled 95.2, and a solid gray bar at “unk” labeled 94.8. For AIME24 panels (d)–(f), the vertical value axis is linear with tick labels from 0 to 90 at regular 10-point intervals, and values are printed above each bar. Panel (d) shows three hatched (TTS) bars: blue at “3B” labeled 30.0, green at “405B” labeled 23.3, and purple at “unk” labeled 9.3. Panel (e) shows three solid (CoT) bars: pink at “unk” labeled 63.6, red hatched (TTS) at “1.5B” labeled 63.3, and brown solid at “unk” labeled 44.6. Panel (f) shows three solid/hatched bars: an orange hatched (TTS) bar at “7B” labeled 83.3, a tan solid (CoT) bar at “671B” labeled 79.8, and a gray solid (CoT) bar at “unk” labeled 79.2. Across all panels, the bars are not visually sorted by height; instead they follow the displayed x-axis order, and several bars include small model/provider icon badges placed near the tops as visual identifiers without additional numeric annotations beyond the printed values.
